data.name: Abhishek Gawande
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Abhishek Gawande has made a big mark in cricket. With 38 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 83*, with an average of 17.38 and a quick strike rate of 167.44. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 38 sixes and 37 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 112.4 overs, taking 50 wickets at an economy rate of 7.28. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
